topic: how to get cash from chase credit card
slug: how to get cash from chase credit card

steps.narration: Open the Chase app and sign in.
Tap your Freedom Unlimited credit card on the home screen.
Tap "Manage account", then tap "Manage PIN" under "Card setup & maintenance".
Request a PIN if you don't have one; it arrives by mail in 5 to 7 business days, or set your own PIN at a Chase branch.
Enter your 16-digit card number and tap "Request PIN".
With your PIN, go to any Visa ATM: insert your credit card, enter the PIN, choose "Cash advance", and enter the amount.
At a Chase branch you don't need a PIN: a teller can process the cash advance with your card and photo ID.
Fees apply: $10 or 5% of the amount (whichever is greater), interest starts immediately, and ATM owners may add their own fee.
